body:
Add a process-level backing timer (setTimeout) in lib/agy.mjs runAgy to forcibly terminate (SIGTERM then SIGKILL) agy child processes if they exceed the print timeout window, ensuring pool slots are never leaked on subprocess hangs.

Acceptance criteria:
1. runAgy sets a process timeout fallback that kills hanging child processes.
2. Timed out processes correctly return kind: "timeout" and error: "print-timeout".
3. Unit tests cover process termination behavior.
4. npm test passes cleanly.
title: feat: enforce process-level SIGKILL fallback on hung runAgy subprocesses
